 Animation didn't just build the foundation of Disney; it remains its bread and butter. Several of Disney's animated hits remain extremely popular on streaming, such as Coco , which is the current No. 1 movie on Disney+.

 FlixPatrol reports that Coco is the No. 1 movie on Disney+, not only in the United States but also globally. The 2017 animated film is ahead of several other major animated movies, such as The Nightmare Before Christmas (No. 2), Coraline (No. 6), and Toy Story 5 (No. 7), on the Top 10 Movies chart. Coco is also ranked higher than the Home Alone and Hocus Pocus movies.
 Coco Is 1 of Disney's Oscar-Winning Pixar Movies
 Coco is the 19th film produced by Pixar Animation Studios. The 105-minute fantasy film follows Miguel (Anthony Gonzalez), a 12-year-old with dreams of becoming a musician despite his family’s generations-old ban on music, who ventures to the vibrant Land of the Dead to unlock the real story behind his family history. The animated movie also featured the voices of Gael García Bernal, Benjamin Bratt, Alanna Ubach, Renée Victor, Ana Ofelia Murguía, and Edward James Olmos.
 Released in November 2017, Coco was a critical and commercial success upon its release. The movie earned near-unanimous acclaim from critics, with review aggregate website Rotten Tomatoes noting an approval rating of 97%. The animated feature also became one of Pixar's highest-grossing movies, with a global box office haul of $814 million. At the 90th Academy Awards, Coco managed to win not only Best Animated Feature but also Best Original Song (for "Remember Me").
 Disney Is Expanding the World of Coco with a Sequel and Theme Park Attraction
 Miguel and Hectór Happily Playing Their Guitars In Coco Image via Walt Disney Studios 
 Despite the critical and commercial success, Pixar did not rush a sequel to Coco into development. Instead, the animation studio waited eight years before announcing Coco 2 , which was unveiled in March 2025 by then-CEO Bob Iger during The Walt Disney Company’s annual meeting of shareholders. "While the film is just in the initial stages, we know it will be full of humor, heart and adventure. And we can't wait to share more soon," Iger said at the time.
 No screenwriter has been revealed yet for Coco 2 . However, Coco director Lee Unkrich and co-director Adrian Molina will both be returning to the director's chairs for the sequel. Oscar-winning producer Mark Nielsen, whose Pixar credits include Toy Story 4 and Inside Out 2 , is also attached to the animated movie.
 At this year's D23 , Benjamin Bratt was confirmed to be reprising his role as the spiritual legendary singer Ernesto de la Cruz, who in the sequel will be out for revenge against the now-teenaged Miguel. "He’s a little menace who ruined a career and destroyed a legend. Ernesto de la Cruz is back for revenge, sending Miguel on an adventure back to the Land of the Dead," Bratt told those in attendance at D23 (via The Hollywood Reporter ).
 In addition to Coco 2 , Disney is expanding the fantasy franchise with a theme park attraction at Disney California Adventure. Construction on the family-friendly boat ride inspired by classic dark rides like Pirates of the Caribbean and The Haunted Mansion is currently in progress near Paradise Gardens Park and Pixar Pier.
 The attraction will be set between Coco and Coco 2 , picking up one year after the events of the 2017 original. Disney Parks describes the upcoming ride as "a beautiful, moving experience full of fun and surprises, leaning heavily into the music and emotion of the cherished Pixar film while inviting you to live Miguel’s journey alongside your own friends and family."
 Coco is available to stream on Disney+. Coco 2 is scheduled to hit theaters on Nov. 21, 2029.
